raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Related to #41110 and based on @Daboolu's original implementation in #36332. Qwen3.5 classification checkpoints need native score-head loading and raw last-token scores through the pooled-output path.

This is a collaborative current-main adaptation with additional regressions. @Daboolu invited us to share the integration changes and tests in https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/41110#issuecomment-6555184597. The original PR remains open. This Draft makes the adaptation reviewable and does not presume which PR maintainers should land; the changes can be consolidated into one landing path. It does not claim the original design as independent work.

Original attribution is retained in the commit with `Co-authored-by: daisijun <sijun.dsj@gmail.com>`. A complete applicable patch and validation notes were shared at https://gist.github.com/nhq-0806/213108eda469d3bbf5003d854855a9aa.

## Modifications

- Add a dedicated dense `Qwen3_5ForSequenceClassification` module, reusing the existing backbone and `score_and_pool` implementation.
- Load the bias-free `score.weight` head and return raw last-token classification/regression scores. Avoid creating an unused vocabulary head and handle tied-embedding checkpoint loading on the AMX branch.
- Register classification, hybrid-cache and multimodal capabilities and processor routing. Preserve the default generation embedding normalization.
- Cover actual checkpoint mapping, forward dispatch, unequal request lengths, one/two-label outputs and caller-selected positions with CPU regressions.
- Add a no-download hybrid-model GPU parity test and a short checkpoint-format note in the reward-model documentation.

## Accuracy Tests

Rebased on main `3edea93cbc0d857026253df0535a4d89791032a3`; tested commit `1c434e6493d70aa74d6d911262b12193090a9fb4`.

Environment: Python3.12.8, PyTorch2.14.1+cu130, Transformers5.19.0; one NVIDIA A10080GB PCIe. The isolated environment omits torchaudio; no audio validation is claimed.

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=999 PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 python -m pytest \
  test/registered/unit/models/test_qwen3_5_sequence_classification.py \
  test/registered/unit/models/test_qwen3_5_packed_weight_loader.py \
  test/registered/unit/models/test_qwen3_5_pipeline_parallel.py \
  test/registered/unit/layers/test_pooler_score_and_pool.py \
  test/registered/unit/configs/test_embedding_model_spec.py -q --disable-warnings
# 37 passed, 17 subtests passed in 16.18s

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python -m pytest \
  test/registered/prefill_only/test_qwen35_classification_parity.py -q --disable-warnings
# 1 passed, 3 subtests passed in 30.23s
```

The GPU fixture has seeded random BF16 weights, one GDN layer and one full-attention layer, two labels and request lengths3/7/129. Batched and individual scores match the Transformers classification reference within atol=rtol=0.02. These are numerical regressions, not trained reward-model quality results. Image/video accuracy, quantization, TP/PP and multi-node execution have not been validated.

Before the implementation, the native architecture registration probe fails and classifies the architecture as generation. A negative control that bypasses the classification head fails both one/two-label numerical regression cases as expected.

## Checks

- All applicable changed-file pre-commit hooks passed; `git diff --check` passed.
- Mintlify build validation and broken links with anchor/redirect checks passed.
- Whole-repository pre-commit was also run on an isolated Windows checkout. It reports existing formatting differences, Windows path handling and unavailable Bash for unrelated Rust hooks. A clean whole-repository run is not claimed, and unrelated automatic changes were not included.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No performance improvement or benchmark result is claimed. The change reuses the existing backbone and adds a small sequence-level score head.

## AI assistance

Implementation, tests and documentation were prepared with Codex assistance. This description reports executed checks and their limits; it does not claim additional human review or maintainer approval.

+"""Native Qwen3.5 scores agree with HF for a small, seeded hybrid checkpoint.
+
+This exercises model loading and the embedding request path; it does not measure
+the quality of a trained reward model. No checkpoint download is required.
+"""
+
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+from transformers import Qwen3_5Config, Qwen3_5ForSequenceClassification
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.engine import Engine
+from sglang.srt.managers.io_struct import EmbeddingReqInput
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=40, stage="base-b", runner_config="1-gpu-small")
+
+
+class TestQwen35ClassificationParity(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.checkpoint = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+        cls.addClassCleanup(cls.checkpoint.cleanup)
+        config = Qwen3_5Config(
+            text_config=dict(
+                vocab_size=128,
+                hidden_size=512,
+                intermediate_size=768,
+                num_hidden_layers=2,
+                num_attention_heads=2,
+                num_key_value_heads=2,
+                head_dim=256,
+                max_position_embeddings=512,
+                layer_types=["linear_attention", "full_attention"],
+                linear_key_head_dim=128,
+                linear_value_head_dim=128,
+                linear_num_key_heads=2,
+                linear_num_value_heads=4,
+                pad_token_id=0,
+                bos_token_id=1,
+                eos_token_id=2,
+                rope_parameters=dict(
+                    rope_type="default",

+                depth=1,

+                spatial_merge_size=2,
+                out_hidden_size=512,

+    def test_batched_and_individual_scores_match_transformers(self):

+"""Qwen3.5 scoring must preserve checkpoint weights and raw hidden-state scale."""
+
+import unittest
+from contextlib import ExitStack
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.srt.configs.model_config import (
+    is_generation_model,
+    is_multimodal_model,
+    is_qwen3_5,
+    is_score_and_pool_model,
+)
+from sglang.srt.models.qwen3_5 import (
+    Qwen3_5ForCausalLM,
+    Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration,
+)
+from sglang.srt.models.qwen3_5_classification import Qwen3_5ForSequenceClassification
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=12, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _backbone_init(self, config, **kwargs):
+    nn.Module.__init__(self)
+    self.embed_tokens = nn.Embedding(config.vocab_size, config.hidden_size)
+    self._start_layer = 0
+    self._end_layer = 1
+
+
+def _backbone_forward(self, input_ids, **kwargs):
+    return self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
+
+
+class TestQwen3_5SequenceClassification(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.boundaries = ExitStack()
+        self.addCleanup(self.boundaries.close)
+        parallel = SimpleNamespace(
+            pp_group=SimpleNamespace(
+                is_first_rank=True, is_last_rank=True, world_size=1
+            ),
+            enable_dp_lm_head=False,
+        )
+        self.boundaries.enter_context(
+            patch("sglang.srt.models.qwen3_vl.get_parallel", return_value=parallel)
+        )
+        self.boundaries.enter_context(
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.models.qwen3_vl.get_mm",
+                return_value=SimpleNamespace(mm_enable_dp_encoder=False),
+            )
+        )
+        self.boundaries.enter_context(
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.models.qwen3_vl.LogitsProcessor", return_value=nn.Identity()
+            )
+        )
+        # Replace only the expensive transformer computation. Construction,
+        # checkpoint mapping, forward dispatch, pooling and scoring remain real.
+        self.boundaries.enter_context(
+            patch.object(Qwen3_5ForCausalLM, "__init__", _backbone_init)
+        )
+        self.boundaries.enter_context(
+            patch.object(Qwen3_5ForCausalLM, "forward", _backbone_forward)
+        )
+        self.config = SimpleNamespace(
+            architectures=["Qwen3_5ForSequenceClassification"],
+            language_model_only=True,
+            tie_word_embeddings=True,
+            num_labels=2,
+            text_config=SimpleNamespace(
+                hidden_size=2, vocab_size=8, rope_scaling={}, rope_parameters={}
+            ),
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _batch(lengths, **overrides):
+        return SimpleNamespace(
+            **{
+                "extend_seq_lens": torch.tensor(lengths),
+                "extend_seq_lens_cpu": lengths,
+                "multi_item_delimiter_indices": None,
+                "token_indices_to_pool": None,
+                "return_pooled_hidden_states": True,
+                "is_prefill_only": True,
+                "dimensions": None,
+                **overrides,
+            }
+        )
+
+    def _model(self, num_labels=2):
+        self.config.num_labels = num_labels
+        model = Qwen3_5ForSequenceClassification(self.config)
+        embeddings = torch.tensor(
+            [
+                [0.0, 0.0],
+                [1.0, 1.0],
+                [3.0, 4.0],
+                [2.0, 2.0],
+                [5.0, 1.0],
+                [6.0, 8.0],
+                [1.0, 0.0],
+                [0.0, 1.0],
+            ]
+        )
+        head = torch.tensor([[2.0, -1.0], [-1.0, 3.0]])[:num_labels]
+        loaded = model.load_weights(
+            [
+                ("model.language_model.embed_tokens.weight", embeddings),
+                ("score.weight", head),
+                ("lm_head.weight", torch.full((8, 2), -99.0)),
+            ]
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(loaded, {"model.embed_tokens.weight", "score.weight"})
+        self.assertIsNone(model.lm_head)
+        self.assertIsNone(model.score.bias)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(model.score.weight, head)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(model.model.embed_tokens.weight, embeddings)
+        return model
+
+    def test_batched_scores_use_raw_last_token_and_checkpoint_head(self):
+        # Unequal request lengths catch selecting a fixed row or the final row
+        # of the whole batch; non-unit states catch embedding normalization.
+        for num_labels in (1, 2):
+            with self.subTest(num_labels=num_labels):
+                model = self._model(num_labels)
+                output = model(
+                    torch.tensor([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]),
+                    torch.tensor([0, 1, 0, 1, 2]),
+                    self._batch([2, 3]),
+                    get_embedding=True,
+                )
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    output.embeddings,
+                    torch.tensor([[2.0, 9.0], [4.0, 18.0]])[:, :num_labels],
+                )
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    output.pooled_hidden_states, torch.tensor([[3.0, 4.0], [6.0, 8.0]])
+                )
+
+    def test_requested_positions_preserve_per_request_scores(self):
+        model = self._model()
+        output = model(
+            torch.tensor([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]),
+            torch.tensor([0, 1, 0, 1, 2]),
+            self._batch(
+                [2, 3], token_indices_to_pool=[torch.tensor([0, 1]), torch.tensor([1])]
+            ),
+            get_embedding=True,
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(len(output.embeddings), 2)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            output.embeddings[0], torch.tensor([[1.0, 2.0], [2.0, 9.0]])
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(output.embeddings[1], torch.tensor([[9.0, -2.0]]))
+
+    def test_tied_checkpoint_load_has_no_amx_generation_head(self):
+        with (
+            patch("sglang.srt.models.qwen3_5._is_cpu", True),
+            patch("sglang.srt.models.qwen3_5._is_amx_available", True),
+        ):
+            self._model()
+
+    def test_generation_class_keeps_embedding_normalization(self):
+        # The shared forward hook must preserve the existing embedding output.
+        self.config.architectures = ["Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration"]
+        with (
+            patch("sglang.srt.models.qwen3_vl._is_cpu_amx_available", False),
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.models.qwen3_5.get_model",
+                return_value=SimpleNamespace(model_path="unused", revision=None),
+            ),
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.models.qwen3_5.load_joint_head_config", return_value=None
+            ),
+        ):
+            model = Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration(self.config)
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            model.model.embed_tokens.weight[2].copy_(torch.tensor([3.0, 4.0]))
+        output = model(
+            torch.tensor([2]), torch.tensor([0]), self._batch([1]), get_embedding=True
+        )
+        self.assertIs(model.lm_head, model.model.embed_tokens)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(output.embeddings, torch.tensor([[0.6, 0.8]]))
+
+    def test_registry_and_serving_capabilities_agree(self):
+        from sglang.srt.models.registry import ModelRegistry
+
+        arch = "Qwen3_5ForSequenceClassification"
+        cls, resolved = ModelRegistry.resolve_model_cls(arch)
+        self.assertIs(cls, Qwen3_5ForSequenceClassification)
+        self.assertEqual(resolved, arch)
+        self.assertFalse(is_generation_model([arch]))
+        self.assertTrue(is_multimodal_model([arch]))
+        self.assertTrue(is_qwen3_5(self.config))
+        self.assertTrue(is_score_and_pool_model([arch]))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

On the published commit, 37 CPU tests/17 subtests and the single-A100 numerical regression/3 subtests passed; hosted lint and the PR title check also passed.

Could a maintainer enable NVIDIA Base CI (`run-ci`) for the registered CPU regressions and `test/registered/prefill_only/test_qwen35_classification_parity.py`?
